metadata.description: Qlub internal Claude Code tools and automation plugins

plugins.name: publish-apk-to-ni
plugins.description: Publish an APK build to Network International's (N-Genius) SFTP server and prepare the release notification email as a Gmail draft. Prompts for the SFTP password and signer name at runtime; stores no credentials.

plugins.name: qba-mock-data
plugins.description: Create synthetic QBA demo venues with payment history on staging from a plain description, for pitches. Uses the person's own staging admin login; staging only.
